QuestInfo.name: Andre's Request
QuestInfo.1: I got a third request from #p406#. #p414#, an assistant at the Kerning City Hair Salon, is a lifelong bachelor and is apparently struggling with improving his cooking skills. He wants to try his hand at making some tasty seafood soup. I'll need to defeat #b30 #o12##k and collect #b20 #t4000012#s#k, and also get #b1 #t2022000##k. Once I've gathered everything, I need to deliver them to #p406#.
QuestInfo.2: I delivered what #p414# asked for and got a glove in return. I hope he enjoys his hearty bowl of Seafood Soup. Return to #p406# for another gig.

0.0: Oh, thanks for coming! I just got a new request in store for you. This time, it's #b#p414##k, the assistant from the Hair Salon. #b#p414##k is actually a lonely guy living by himself. He's apparently sick and tired of eating the same old junk.
0.1: Well, I can whip up some delicious Seafood Soup using #b20 #t4000012#s#k and #b1 #t2022000##k. That should be easy enough, right? Come see me after you've defeated #b30 #o12##k and collected everything. I'll be waiting!

1.0: I knew I could count on you. Since you've done such a wonderful job following through with the request, here's your reward. #b#p414##k is giving you a glove that'll help you on your journey, so go ahead and take it!

yes.0: All right, if you need work sometime down the road, feel free to come back and see me.

item.0: I see you still haven't gathered the materials that #b#p414##k requested. I need #b20 #t4000012#s#k and #b1 #t2022000##k in order to make some delicious Seafood Soup. Just bring everything to me. Good luck!

mob.0: I see you still haven't completed everything that #b#p414##k requested. Don't forget, you also need to defeat #b30 #o12##k!
